## Description

This PR backports the MTP training work from upstream [7823be6d70abd7347d8affd52b88cc7ef698baef](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/commit/7823be6d70abd7347d8affd52b88cc7ef698baef) to the `ascend` branch, adapted for the NPU Megatron-Bridge and xccl paths.

Enable Megatron MTP training with an independent auxiliary objective while preserving complete HF checkpoints when MTP training is disabled. Frozen MTP tensors are captured from the checkpoint actually loaded, so saving after a resume preserves that checkpoint's head.

- Add `megatron.enable_mtp_training` and `mtp_loss_scaling_factor` (default `0.1`) with packed-sequence and context-parallel normalization, VPP metadata propagation, and `mtp_loss` reporting.
- Isolate auxiliary gradients from policy parameters while retaining the existing shared global gradient clipping.
- Preserve frozen MTP weights and configuration during HF export, rebuild shard metadata from safetensors headers, and propagate rank-zero checkpoint errors to peers.
- Require Megatron-Bridge and one prediction layer for MTP training; reject LoRA, critic, tree-attention, and AWEX training combinations. Trained-MTP xccl updates require `use_bridge_for_update_weights: true`.
- Update example configs and English/Chinese CLI references, and add MTP loss and vLLM drafter-loader coverage to Ascend CI.

## Related Issue

No linked issue.

## Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [x] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ✅ Test coverage improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [x] Relevant CPU and dependency tests pass; new regression tests added
- [x] Documentation updated (English/Chinese CLI references regenerated; documentation site not built)
- [x] Branch is up to date with the target `ascend` branch
- [x] Self-reviewed via the `review-pr` workflow
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `create-pr`
- [x] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details:** Rename `megatron.enable_mtp` to `megatron.enable_mtp_training` in existing configs. No compatibility alias is retained. Frozen-MTP checkpoint paths must be local directories.

## Additional Context

This change targets the Ascend/NPU Megatron path. MTP and policy gradients share global clipping, so the auxiliary loss can still affect the policy's clipping scale.

Validation:

- `pre-commit run --all-files`: passed on the final commit tree.
- `pytest -q tests/test_mtp_training.py tests/test_megatron_bridge_config.py tests/test_megatron_loss_normalization.py tests/test_megatron_loss_aggregation.py tests/test_model_packed_seq_cp.py tests/test_mindspeed_pipeline_layout_patch.py -m 'not npu and not multi_npu and not cuda and not nccl'`: 698 passed, 1 skipped, 16 deselected before the final five-line removal of redundant export checks.
- `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 pytest -q tests/test_mtp_training.py`: 36 passed after that cleanup.
- `pytest -q tests/test_model_packed_seq_cp.py tests/test_vllm_mtp_weights.py`: 18 passed against the installed NPU-container libraries, using CPU execution from an isolated source copy.
- All 22 embedded workflow shell steps passed syntax checks.

The [first NPU CI run](https://github.com/areal-project/AReaL/actions/runs/41544034037/job/125615060322) passed both native MTP loss/gradient tests (CP=1 and CP=2), plus dense and MoE HF save/load tests. Its 16 loss-aggregation failures shared one test-fixture error: the simulated engine lacked `mcore_config`. Commit `2c591a2dc` explicitly disables MTP in that fixture; the native loss-aggregation rerun is pending.

A full engine forward/backward run with MTP training enabled on the exact rebased PR head and a live Qwen3.6-35B-A3B xccl update to the vLLM drafter remain unverified. The isolated native MTP loss tests do not establish those runtime paths.

### Results: Qwen3.5-2B on Geometry3K

`num_speculative_tokens=4`.

| Metric | First 20 steps | Last 20 steps | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| MTP loss | 0.768 | 0.542 | −29.5% |
| Rollout acceptance rate | 42.74% | 51.35% | +8.60 percentage points |

![MTP loss](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Adiactive/AReaL/9e5a80a82afd4a56930bf4486706ade089a87bd6/qwen35-2b-mtp-loss.png)

![Rollout acceptance rate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Adiactive/AReaL/67b301e7ec9421474e88a97f21fbbcd46d6f1408/qwen35-2b-acceptance-rate.png)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+"""CPU-owned MTP weights for full HF checkpoints with MTP training disabled."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import struct
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from safetensors import safe_open
+from safetensors.torch import save_file
+
+_MTP_COUNTS = ("mtp_num_hidden_layers", "num_nextn_predict_layers")
+
+
+def is_mtp_key(name: str) -> bool:
+    return any(part == "mtp" or part.startswith("nextn") for part in name.split("."))
+
+
+def _read_safetensors_header(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    with path.open("rb") as f:
+        header_size = struct.unpack("<Q", f.read(8))[0]
+        header = json.loads(f.read(header_size))
+    header.pop("__metadata__", None)
+    return header
+
+
+def read_mtp_tensors(source: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+    """Read every declared MTP tensor, rejecting missing shards or keys."""
+    root = Path(source)
+    index = root / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.exists():
+        weight_map = json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"]
+    else:
+        with safe_open(root / "model.safetensors", framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
+            weight_map = {name: "model.safetensors" for name in f.keys()}
+    shards: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for name, filename in weight_map.items():
+        if is_mtp_key(name):
+            shards.setdefault(filename, []).append(name)
+    result = {}
+    for filename, names in shards.items():
+        with safe_open(root / filename, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
+            result[filename] = {name: f.get_tensor(name).clone() for name in names}
+    return result
+
+
+def _mtp_config(config: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        if key in _MTP_COUNTS:
+            result[key] = value
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            nested = _mtp_config(value)
+            if nested:
+                result[key] = nested
+    return result
+
+
+def _merge_config(config: dict[str, Any], mtp: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    for key, value in mtp.items():
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            _merge_config(config.setdefault(key, {}), value)
+        else:
+            config[key] = value
+
+
+def validate_mtp_checkpoint(source: str) -> None:
+    """Require MTP weights before Bridge loads a trainable head."""
+    root = Path(source)
+    index = root / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+    if index.exists():
+        names = json.loads(index.read_text())["weight_map"]
+    else:
+        with safe_open(root / "model.safetensors", framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
+            names = f.keys()
+    if not any(is_mtp_key(name) for name in names):
+        raise ValueError(f"No MTP weights found in {source}")
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FrozenMTPState:
+    """An immutable-by-ownership snapshot, independent of the original files."""
+
+    shards: dict[str, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]
+    config: dict[str, Any]
+
+    @classmethod
+    def load(cls, source: str) -> FrozenMTPState:
+        root = Path(source)
+        config = json.loads((root / "config.json").read_text())
+        shards = read_mtp_tensors(str(root))
+        if not shards:
+            raise ValueError(f"No frozen MTP weights found in {source}")
+        return cls(shards=shards, config=_mtp_config(config))
+
+    def export(self, destination: str) -> None:
+        """Merge only MTP-owned tensors and rebuild a complete shard index."""
+        root = Path(destination)
+        existing = {}
+        for path in root.glob("*.safetensors"):
+            for key in _read_safetensors_header(path):
+                if key in existing:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Duplicate tensor in HF export: {key}")
+                existing[key] = path.name
+        single = root / "model.safetensors"
+        sidecar = root / "model-mtp.safetensors"
+        updates = {}
+        for filename, tensors in self.shards.items():
+            for key, tensor in tensors.items():
+                target = existing.get(key)
+                if target is None:
+                    if single.exists():
+                        # Transformers prefers this file over the shard index.
+                        target = single.name
+                    elif (root / filename).exists():
+                        target = filename
+                    else:
+                        target = sidecar.name
+                updates.setdefault(target, {})[key] = tensor
+        for filename, tensors in updates.items():
+            path = root / filename
+            merged = {}
+            if path.exists():
+                with safe_open(path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as f:
+                    merged = {key: f.get_tensor(key).clone() for key in f.keys()}
+            merged.update(tensors)
+            save_file(merged, path, metadata={"format": "pt"})
+        weight_map = {}
+        total_size = 0
+        for path in sorted(root.glob("*.safetensors")):
+            for key, metadata in _read_safetensors_header(path).items():
+                weight_map[key] = path.name
+                begin, end = metadata["data_offsets"]
+                total_size += end - begin
+        index_path = root / "model.safetensors.index.json"
+        index = json.loads(index_path.read_text()) if index_path.exists() else {}
+        # Only the intentionally unbuilt MTP tensors may have been absent.
+        missing = set(index.get("weight_map", {})) - weight_map.keys()
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError(f"Incomplete HF export; missing {sorted(missing)}")
+        index["weight_map"] = weight_map
+        index.setdefault("metadata", {})["total_size"] = total_size
+        index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
+        config_path = root / "config.json"
+        config = json.loads(config_path.read_text())
+        _merge_config(config, self.config)
+        config_path.write_text(json.dumps(config, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

+_MTP_BATCH = contextvars.ContextVar("areal_mtp_batch", default=None)
+
+_MTP_TRAIN_LABELS = contextvars.ContextVar("areal_mtp_labels", default=None)
+_MTP_TRAIN_LOSS_MASK = contextvars.ContextVar("areal_mtp_mask", default=None)

+def _wrap_forward_for_mtp_kwargs(model_cls) -> None:
+    """Carry auxiliary targets through logits-only model forwards."""
+    _orig_forward = model_cls.forward
+
+    @wraps(_orig_forward)
+    def _patched_forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        mtp_kwargs = kwargs.pop("mtp_kwargs", None)
+        mtp_labels = mtp_kwargs.get("mtp_labels") if mtp_kwargs else None
+        mtp_loss_mask = mtp_kwargs.get("mtp_loss_mask") if mtp_kwargs else None
+        # Multimodal wrappers pass precomputed decoder_input and deliberately
+        # set language_model.input_ids=None. MCore still needs token IDs inside
+        # the MTP block to build the shifted token embeddings, so restore the
+        # layout-aligned IDs from the independent MTP channel in that case.
+        if (
+            mtp_labels is not None
+            and "input_ids" in kwargs
+            and kwargs["input_ids"] is None
+        ):
+            kwargs["input_ids"] = mtp_labels
+        batch_token = _MTP_BATCH.set(mtp_kwargs.get("batch") if mtp_kwargs else None)
+        labels_token = _MTP_TRAIN_LABELS.set(mtp_labels)
+        mask_token = _MTP_TRAIN_LOSS_MASK.set(mtp_loss_mask)
+        try:
+            return _orig_forward(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            _MTP_TRAIN_LOSS_MASK.reset(mask_token)
+            _MTP_TRAIN_LABELS.reset(labels_token)
+            _MTP_BATCH.reset(batch_token)
+
+    model_cls.forward = _patched_forward
+
+
+def _roll_mtp_labels(
+    mtp_labels,
+    roll_tensor,
+    *,
+    cp_group=None,
+    packed_seq_params=None,
+):
+    """Align raw input IDs with MCore's next-token label convention."""
+    roll_kwargs = {
+        "shifts": -1,
+        "dims": -1,
+        "cp_group": cp_group,
+        "packed_seq_params": packed_seq_params,
+    }
+    rolled_labels, _ = roll_tensor(mtp_labels.clone(), **roll_kwargs)
+    return rolled_labels
+
+
+def _detach_mtp_output_weight(output_layer, output_weight):
+    """Detach the effective output weight for both tied and untied models."""
+    if output_weight is None:
+        # MCore only passes output_weight explicitly when the LM head is tied
+        # to the input embedding. Untied models instead let output_layer use
+        # its internal trainable weight when weight=None.
+        output_weight = getattr(output_layer, "weight", None)
+    if output_weight is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "MTP gradient isolation requires an explicit shared output weight "
+            "or an output layer with an internal weight."

+def _mtp_loss(
+    hidden_states,
+    labels,
+    loss_mask,
+    output_layer,
+    output_weight,
+    runtime_gather_output,
+    is_training,
+    compute_language_model_loss,
+    config,
+    cp_group=None,
+    packed_seq_params=None,
+    scale_logits_fn=None,
+):

+    from megatron.core.transformer.multi_token_prediction import (
+        MTPLossAutoScaler,
+        roll_tensor,
+    )
+
+    main_hidden, mtp_hidden = torch.chunk(hidden_states, 2, dim=0)
+    raw_labels = _MTP_TRAIN_LABELS.get()
+    mask = _MTP_TRAIN_LOSS_MASK.get()
+    if mask is None:
+        raise ValueError("MTP training requires a loss mask")
+    targets = _roll_mtp_labels(
+        raw_labels, roll_tensor, cp_group=cp_group, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+    )
+    roll_kwargs = dict(
+        shifts=-1, dims=-1, cp_group=cp_group, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
+    )
+    targets, _ = roll_tensor(targets, **roll_kwargs)
+    mask, _ = roll_tensor(mask.clone(), **roll_kwargs)
+    logits, _ = output_layer(
+        mtp_hidden,
+        weight=_detach_mtp_output_weight(output_layer, output_weight),
+        runtime_gather_output=runtime_gather_output,
+    )
+    if scale_logits_fn is not None:
+        logits = scale_logits_fn(logits)

+    if batch is None:
+        raise ValueError("MTP training requires whole-batch normalization")
+    if is_training:

+            torch.stack((losses.detach().float().sum(), mask.sum().float()))
+        )

+        main_hidden, losses * config.mtp_loss_scaling_factor * batch["scale"]

+def prepare_mtp_mask(
+    mask: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    old_cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor | None = None,

+    """Exclude sequence ends and count valid two-token-ahead targets."""
+    mask = mask.clone()
+    if cu_seqlens is None:
+        mask[..., -1] = 0

+    lengths = cu_seqlens[1:] - cu_seqlens[:-1]
+    if old_cu_seqlens is not None:
+        lengths = old_cu_seqlens[1:] - old_cu_seqlens[:-1]
+    mask[cu_seqlens[1:].long() - 1] = 0
+    mask[starts[: lengths.numel()] + lengths.long() - 1] = 0
